description: Captured at Da Nang air base on 29 March 1975 and afterwards used in the bombing of Tan Son Nhat air base.
Captured in 1975 and subsequently used in the opening phase of the Cambodian-Vietnamese war. Also captioned locally as an L-19.
Aircraft of the 931st Regiment flown by Nguyen Van Nghia when he shot down a US F-4 Phantom over Bac Thai province in 1972.
Aircraft of the 931st Regiment flown by Le Khuong.
Captured in 1975 and afterwards used in the Cambodian-Vietnamese war. US Army serial as given by the museum listing.
SA-2 Guideline round displayed outdoors; used by the 275th Regiment of the 375th Air Defence Division.
P-15 Termit (SS-N-2 Styx) anti-ship missile in the outdoor park.
